blockers.detail: reports.connector_activity_month and reports.driver_activity_month are created by migration 0002 and have ZERO writers. The flat-fee feeder therefore has no count source and every period holds. Applying 0002 does not by itself make an invoice possible.

'Active driver' is defined as charging OR REPORTING activity. Reporting activity has no persisted event of any kind. deriveActiveDrivers refuses rather than returning the charging-only lower bound, because at 50 kr per driver per month the shortfall is invisible on the invoice that omits it.

The API now emits costAurar instead of costIsk. The Flutter patch is written as a diff in docs/notes/2026-08-18-money-unit-boundary.md sections 5.2-5.4 and must land before this branch's API reaches an environment the app talks to.

dev/straumvakt-org-relaunch at 82c63ac fails npm run typecheck with 118 errors, all under tools/zaptec-test, because the root tsconfig excluded every other standalone tree but not tools/**. Fixed on this branch in one line; the fix belongs on canonical too.

blockers.severity: double-billing remains unlikely rather than impossible
blockers.detail: agreements.billing_lines has only a plain index on (session_id, factor_code, kind). Application code closed the read-decide gap as far as it can; only the constraint makes a concurrent double-write impossible. Needs a dedupe-then-index migration - preflight pack delta 9.1.

RateComponentKind is only dso|retailer|cpo_addon, settlement_components.session_id is NOT NULL and the flat fee has no session, and settlement_holds.session_id is NOT NULL so a period-level hold has no row to be. Preflight pack deltas 9.2-9.4.

corrections: The cross-tenant CDR hole is NOT a token collision: identity.id_tokens.value is globally UNIQUE so a collision is unreachable, and the table has no org_id column so an org-scoped lookup does not exist. The reachable failure needs no coincidence - the lookup never checked membership at all.
The Flutter client was not uniformly compensating: DriverHistorySession divides by 100, ActiveSession does not, so in-flight cost is 100x too large in production today.
per_connector is NOT ahead of the Postgres column: 19bb4ef was atomic across all four declarations and shipped migration 0001_regular_talos.sql with it. The comment claiming otherwise is corrected.
A subscription line cannot be stored as a settlement component under the 0002 schema; statement lines are supported, components are not.
My own: the first cdr-driver-resolution implementation keyed tokens into Map<string,CdrTokenRow>, so the ambiguity check could never fire on the case it was written for. Caught by my own test.

My own: I rewrote a source file with PowerShell and double-encoded its UTF-8 - the exact failure my standing note warns against. Caught immediately, rewritten, encoding verified across all touched files before committing.
next_actions: Carry the tools/** tsconfig exclusion to canonical - npm run check is red on the mainline and the billing lane did not cause it.
Assign an owner to the Flutter patch in docs/notes/2026-08-18-money-unit-boundary.md sections 5.2-5.4; the API change is not safe to deploy until it lands.

Read section 9.6 of docs/notes/2026-08-18-migration-0002-preflight.md before authorising the apply - the activity-count source, not the migration, is what stands between here and customer 1's first invoice.
Decide what makes a driver 'active'. Narrowing to charging activity is a one-line change in deriveActiveDrivers and a commercial decision elsewhere.

very_tldr: Core billing merged onto dev/core-billing-integration with zero conflicts and all 20 gates met: money now leaves the API in aurar under a name that says so, a CDR is attributed only to a driver the host actually has, generation decides by natural key instead of by counting, and the flat-fee feeder refuses rather than inventing a count. Four written claims were false and are corrected, including the census's own description of the cross-tenant hole. Canonical is red on its own typecheck for a reason this branch did not cause and has fixed.
